Package com.im.njams.sdk.settings

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ClientSettings
    Read/write view of the nJAMS SDK settings.
    SettingsProvider Deprecated.
    Use ClientSettings instead.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AbstractReadOnlySettings
    Skeletal base for ReadOnlyClientSettings implementations.
    HierarchicalSettings
    A ClientSettings that composes an ordered list of named layers.
    HierarchicalSettings.Builder
    Fluent builder for a HierarchicalSettings instance.
    HierarchicalSettings.FilterableLayerBuilder
    Extension of the builder chain returned after HierarchicalSettings.Builder.andThenSystemProperties() or HierarchicalSettings.Builder.andThenEnvironmentVariables().
    Settings Deprecated.
    This class is preserved only as a legacy implementation of ClientSettings for backwards compatibility with existing client code.
    SettingsProviderFactory Deprecated.
    Use ClientSettings factory methods directly instead: ClientSettings.from(java.util.Map), ClientSettings.from(java.util.Properties), ClientSettings.fromSystemProperties(java.util.function.Predicate), or ReadOnlyClientSettings.fromEnvironment(java.util.function.Predicate) for a read-only environment-backed view.
